artifact_package:
State machine for one 10-minute Grok cycle: INIT (load memory-before) → BRIDGE_PING (127.0.0.1:7354/health) → HEALTH_CHECK (must succeed) → TASK_PROPOSE (exactly one task) → DIRECTOR_EXECUTE (CDP + gated bridge call) → MEMORY_UPDATE → COMPLETE (or ESCALATE on timeout/error). Hard 10min cap forces COMPLETE.
Exact memory-before-action fields: task_id (str), cycle_start (float), current_state (str), budget_used (int), last_bridge_audit (str), provider_calls (int=0).
Exact memory-after-action fields: updated_state (str), result_summary (dict: status, duration_sec, audit_id), memory_hash (str), budget_remaining (int), next_state (str).
Provider-call gating rules for InternAI and LongCat: allowed only after HEALTH_CHECK success on 7354, max 1 call per cycle, read-only tasks only, target must pass bridge allowlist, audit via 7354 before/after call.
Codex escalation conditions: HEALTH_CHECK fail, provider_calls >1, budget_used exceeds limit, high-risk intent, cycle duration >540s, private target detected.
tests_and_verification:
Test 1: Director init loads memory-before fields. Expected: current_state=INIT, provider_calls=0, memory file created in runtime dir.
Test 2: Mock 7354/health success advances state machine to TASK_PROPOSE. Expected: current_state=TASK_PROPOSE, no escalation, 0 provider calls.
Test 3: Provider call attempt before HEALTH_CHECK triggers gate + escalate. Expected: escalation condition met, no actual provider invocation, state=ESCALATE.
Test 4: Memory-after-action persists hash/budget without data exposure. Expected: memory_hash updated, budget_remaining recorded, result_summary contains only status/audit_id/duration.
Test 5: Full mocked 10min cycle with 1 gated provider call after health check reaches COMPLETE. Expected: state=COMPLETE, provider_calls=1, duration logged <600s, no private target or retry.
